subject: Aligning roles & timing for tri-cloud SI co-sell demo / runbook
messages:
From: Joel Patel <joel.patel@bridgegrid.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Cloudbridge SI Team <si@cloudbridge.com>, Anna Helix <anna@helixpartners.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Dec 2026 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: BridgeGrid x Redwood tri-cloud co-sell demo — proposed windows

Hi Sean / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the dive last week — BridgeGrid is excited to do a joint demo with Redwood + Cloudbridge + Helix (GCP SI) for the procurement committee on our side. High-level ask: 45-minute technical demo focused on multi-region failover + cost controls, followed by a 15-minute Q&A.

We have two candidate slots based on our exec availability (all times PT):
- Tue Dec 21, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Dec 22, 14:00–15:00

Can you confirm which one works for Redwood? We also need a short run of show and list of presenters (who owns the AWS/Azure/GCP segments, SI handoffs, and who will handle the post-demo follow-up items).

Attachments: procurement asks (PDF) — I can send after you confirm availability.

Appreciate a quick sync so we can lock the calendar.

— Joel
Joel Patel
Director, Technical Partnerships | BridgeGrid
joel.patel@bridgegrid.com
+1 (415) 555-0194

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Joel Patel <joel.patel@bridgegrid.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Cloudbridge SI Team <si@cloudbridge.com>, Anna Helix <anna@helixpartners.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Dec 2026 10:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: BridgeGrid x Redwood tri-cloud co-sell demo — proposed windows

Joel — thanks, this is great. Either slot is potentially fine for us; want to align on a few logistics before I lock anything:

1) Role matrix: who presents each cloud path? My proposal: Karthik leads the AWS walkthrough (latency/fallback), Anna covers the GCP SI implications, and Vanessa/Neha handle Azure and the post-demo ops (cost controls, cache/batching). I'll open the demo and do the brief platform intro.

2) Run-of-show (45 + 15):
- 00:00–03:00: Sean — 3-min intro + objectives
- 03:00–18:00: Karthik — AWS demo (failover exercise + metrics)
- 18:00–30:00: Anna — GCP SI handoff & edge-case failback
- 30:00–40:00: Vanessa — Azure/quantization & cost controls
- 40:00–45:00: Live multi-cloud failover exercise (short)
- 45:00–60:00: Q&A and next steps (BridgeGrid + Redwood action items)

3) Recording + artifacts: we’ll capture a recording and share the slides. I’ve attached a runbook draft (runbook-draft-v2.pdf) with a suggested slide deck order. Please flag any missing pieces.

4) Timezone fallbacks: if your procurement committee needs APAC-friendly time we can propose Thu Dec 23, 02:00–03:00 PT as a backup (not ideal but possible).

If that matrix looks OK, I’ll send a calendar invite for Wed Dec 22 14:00–15:00 PT (my preference to give everyone runway).

Thanks,

— Sean Gallagher
Sr. Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
+1 (650) 555-0142
Attachments: runbook-draft-v2.pdf

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Joel Patel <joel.patel@bridgegrid.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Cloudbridge SI Team <si@cloudbridge.com>, Anna Helix <anna@helixpartners.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Dec 2026 13:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: BridgeGrid x Redwood tri-cloud co-sell demo — proposed windows

Thanks Sean — quick ops notes from my side: 

- Confirming Wed Dec 22, 14:00–15:00 PT works for Redwood Ops. I’ll own pre-demo run checks (env sanity, credentials, kill-switch).
- Karthik: can you add the exact AMI/container tag you’ll use for the failover demo so I can stage the shadow infra?
- Neha: please draft the post-demo follow-up note templates (action items, gating criteria).

I’ll create the calendar invite (calendar-invite.ics) and include the runbook and the compact deck. Also adding a short checklist to the runbook:
- Pre-demo smoke (15 min prior)
- Recording & transcript enabled
- Primary and fallback presenters on video/audio
- Post-demo: share recording + slide deck + action item list within 24 hours

— Vanessa Ortiz
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: calendar-invite.ics

Thanks, all — Wed Dec 22 14:00–15:00 PT is confirmed from BridgeGrid’s side. A couple of quick asks so we can prep the procurement panel: 

- Could you send a one-line bio for each presenter (title + 1-sentence area of responsibility)? Procurement likes to know who will speak to security/compliance issues.
- We’ll need the list of breakout leads for post-demo technical deep dives (email and role).

Anna — can you confirm your availability for the Wed slot and whether you want 10 minutes of setup time with Vanessa beforehand?

Appreciate it — I’ll wait for the bios and final calendar invite before I loop in the procurement panel.

— Joel

Date: Sat, 11 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Final: Wed Dec 22 14:00 PT — presenter bios, breakout leads & runbook

Joel / team — locking Wed Dec 22, 14:00–15:00 PT and attaching the final artifacts. Quick items below and attachments: bridgegrid-compact-deck.pptx, runbook-draft-v2.pdf (updated), calendar-invite.ics.

Presenter one-liners (as requested):
- Sean Gallagher — Sr. Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference. Platform intro and outcomes owner.
- Karthik Iyer — Lead Solutions Architect, Redwood (AWS). Will run the failover demo and speak to low-latency routing and kernel selection.
- Anna Helix — Principal Systems Integrator, HelixPartners (GCP). Will lead the GCP handoff and failure-mode analysis.
- Vanessa Ortiz — Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood (Azure / ops). Owns pre-demo ops, kill-switch, and post-demo artifacts.

Breakout leads (post-demo):
- AWS deep dive: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
- GCP SI: Anna Helix <anna@helixpartners.com>
- Cost & quantization: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>

Run-of-show (final):
- 00:00–03:00: Sean — intro & objectives
- 03:00–17:00: Karthik — AWS failover + metrics
- 17:00–30:00: Anna — GCP edge-case failback
- 30:00–40:00: Vanessa — Azure cost/quantization controls
- 40:00–45:00: Live tri-cloud failover demo (short)
- 45:00–60:00: Q&A / next steps

Pre-demo checklist (I’ll run):
- 15 min prior: smoke test + recording check
- Verify access tokens and redacted logs for procurement
- Shared slide deck + action-items doc ready to send within 24 hours

If anything else needed for procurement (SOC docs, retention policy snapshot), ping Neha and I’ll surface the artifacts. Otherwise I’ll send the calendar invite now.

See you on Wed.

— Sean Gallagher
Sr. Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
